deviations.reason: ConPTY consumes the child's DECSET mouse/focus negotiation before Termwright's VT observer can prove the active protocol. Generic fixtures without a production-parser provider remain fail-closed. Instrumented applications no longer do: the shipped Ink probe shadows the bytes the application writes and publishes the resulting modes as terminal-input-modes evidence, so pointer-input is supported and real input crosses ConPTY without any fixture standing in. The limitation is therefore observability by the terminal, not functional impossibility.
deviations.evidence: docs/architecture/audit/platform-completion-baseline.json; packages/probe-ink/src/provider.pty.test.ts "routes a click on a terminal that cannot report its own input modes" reproduces the ConPTY condition on every platform
deviations.removalCondition: The certified backend exposes application input-mode negotiation universally, so generic applications no longer need production-parser evidence.
deviations.revalidate: each node-pty, ConPTY backend, or Windows certification change
